title: Climbing to a better neighboring integer
description: You can follow a best-neighbor search on the supplied objective.

steps.description: hill_climb gathers all neighbors and selects the one with the highest f value. You stop when there are no neighbors or the best neighbor fails to improve the current value.
f_int scores integers with a parabola and a small bonus at multiples of five. N_int offers only x minus one and x plus one.

steps.question: Does the stopping condition allow a move to an equally valued neighbor?
steps.answer: No. The <= comparison returns the current state when the best neighbor ties it.

steps.description: You begin at zero and follow improving neighboring states. The supplied output reports Local optimum: 7 value: 50.0.
